messages:
priya: Quick sync — ACME wants 99.95% p99 latency for Dedicated pools on gen2 GPUs at seq_len=512. They say it's a launch blocker unless we commit. Is that a firm requirement for the PRD or negotiable? Also: they care about autoscale cold-start and canary rollback behavior.

mike: Short answer: treat 99.95% p99 as customer ask for enterprise commits, but PRD should set the public baseline at 99.9% with a clear path to 99.95 for reserved customers. We need a cost delta estimate + acceptance criteria. @ana can you sketch perf/throughput numbers for 512?

ana: Quick numbers (rough): one A100-80GB eqv with our runtime at 512 + q8_0 quant -> ~180-220 rps steady, with continuous batching and prefix cache we can hit bursts ~320 rps. If using newer gen2 kernels expect ~250 rps baseline. Cold-start (empty cache) warmup to ~80% throughput in ~20-40s depending on model size.

ana: Sample autoscale knobs I'm testing: ```
scale_up_threshold: 0.8 # target util
scale_up_window: 30s
scale_up_increment: +1 instance
scale_down_cooldown: 300s
queue_max_time: 15s
```

tom: From SRE perspective: GA baseline SLA = 99.9 p99 is OK. 99.95 should be offered as part of reserved commitments with capacity guarantees. Autoscale SLOs we want in PRD: scale-up within 45s for sustained >1.2x baseline, and scale-down cooldown 5m. Must define queuing fallback: if queue_time > 15s, route to lower-cost model variant or degrade gracefully. Also need an automated rollback policy for canaries and a runbook.

leah: CS notes: ACME will push back unless we show canary plan + prompt-set regressions. They asked for a customer-facing doc that lists what triggers an SLA credit and the expected remediation timeline. Also want a small pilot with their prompt set in a canary.

mike: OK action list for the PRD: 1) Add SLA tiers (public 99.9, reserved 99.95 with commit) and explicit cost delta range. 2) Acceptance gates: perf matrix meeting throughput targets, regression tests on customer prompts, failover/fallback verified in canary. 3) Autoscale playbook + operator runbook. 4) Canary thresholds: error rate <0.5% and median latency regression <5% vs baseline, otherwise rollback. 5) Define cold-start target: 90% throughput within 30s. Anyone object?

priya: No objections. Important to capture edge-case: transient region outages — require cross-region fallback within 2m for reserved SLAs. Add to PRD.

ana: I'll run the perf matrix (3 model sizes, q8_0 vs q4) and post results by Fri. I'll also attach a CSV of rps/latency percentiles to thread when done.

tom: I'll draft the autoscale playbook + canary rollback steps by EOD Tue. Will include runbook commands and the list of metrics to alert on.

leah: I'll coordinate the ACME pilot and collect their prompt set. ETA next Wed.
